about_the_game:
"Mallow & The Street of the Fallen" is an RPG game produced by エンタングルメント and published by Hanabi games.

Game Overview

The story takes place in the Kingdom of Anatal, a land that has finally regained peace after years of territorial disputes.

Now, the kingdom is bustling with adventurers from all over the world.

Deep beneath the sacred mountains in the northern region—where the air is thick with magical energy—a massive labyrinth has been discovered.

A few days later, the Kingdom of Anatal announced that the labyrinth once belonged to an ancient kingdom that worshipped a primordial god.

Adventurers who saw this news rushed to Anatal, eager to uncover the lost treasures that may still lie dormant within the labyrinth.

Among them are two young adventurers who step into the kingdom—our story’s protagonists, Mallow and Theo.

The mountains of Blankemont, saturated with dense magical energy, are home to countless powerful monsters.
The deeper into the mountains one goes, and the higher the altitude, the stronger these monsters become.
For this reason, Blankemont is known as the most dangerous mountain range in the land.

Seeking greater strength, Mallow and Theo arrive in search of a training ground.
However, due to the discovery of the gigantic underground labyrinth, inns across the entire kingdom are packed full.
With no other choice, the two are forced to stay in the infamously lawless district of Yulcolam…

Game Features

  • High freedom of exploration

  • JRPG elements

  • Turn-based combat

  • Rich interactive storylines

Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 8/8.1/10
  • Processor: 2+ GHz Processor
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 8/8.1/10
  • Processor: 3+ GHz Processor
  • Graphics: OpenGL ES 2.0 hardware driver support required for WebGL acceleration. (AMD Catalyst 10.9, nVidia 358.50)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
